verdict.rationale: The Scribe docs give per-model language coverage: ten languages on zoom-scribe-multilingual, 26 more locales on whisper, and an English-only Pro model (zoom-scribe-en-pro). The evidence shows only counts, not the named list of languages or locales, and per-feature language differences are only implied by 'when supported by the selected model'. missing for 10: the concrete enumerated list of languages/locales per model, an explicit per-feature language support matrix (e.g. diarization, polishing, profanity filter by language), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the supported languages are published as a concrete list, with any per-model or per-feature differences stated

citations.quote: Recognizes ten languages with the zoom-scribe-multilingual model and 26 additional locales with the whisper model
For higher English accuracy, select the Pro option, Scribe API Pro High-Accuracy, with the model ID zoom-scribe-en-pro.
Filter profanity when supported by the selected model.
